name: Case-Based Divergent Scoring
description: Replaces an algebraic sum-of-squares constraint with a custom case-based scoring system where the penalty for the "both selected" state is deliberately diverged from its natural algebraic value (changing 4 to 5). This preserves the unique solution (zero occurrences of that state) while breaking any algebraic pattern matching that relies on recognizing the sequence of squares. Models that attempt to algebraically simplify the condition will fail to find a clean reduction, forcing them to reason about the inequalities of the cases from scratch.
